feature.heading: What it does
feature.note: 3 free downloads per day, no cookies, public pages only
feature.platformsBody: Any link that opens publicly is handed to the built-in parsing engine. Try it without signing up, and no platform cookies are collected.
feature.qualityBody: Condensed to 1080p, 720p, 480p and audio only. The best option up to 1080p is selected by default.
feature.phoneBody: Save files on a phone browser too — no desktop software needed.

highlights.heading: Highlights
highlights.note: Free is enough; membership is roomier
highlights.quotaBody: Try it without signing up. Resets at midnight.
highlights.qualityBody: The best option up to 1080p is selected by default
highlights.toolsBody: Download, summary, subtitles, mind map and Q&A share one URL
highlights.memberBody: Unlimited downloads, 2GB per file, 4 concurrent tasks, 30 minutes

member.heading: Membership
